# Import Gas Meter Text File

Use the Text File Import screen to bring in data from a text file that uses Quroum's text file format (contact <a href="mailto:flowcal.support@quorumsoftware.com" class="InlineLink">Customer Support</a> for the file format). The file can be used to import gas meter data for one or more meters.

<div class="procedure">

To import a gas meter text file:

1.  Go to **Import** \> **Gas Meter Text File**.

2.  Click the **Browse** button to locate a text file to import (example: C:\data\01301-July.txt), or type the file path into the **Import File** field.

3.  Select the data resolution (Meter Characteristic, 15 Minute, 1 Hour, or 1 Day). If you select "Meter Characteristic", FLOWCAL uses the resolution defined in the meter characteristic data.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 404;height: 225;" />

4.  If applicable, select **Treat records with same start and end date as daily record**. With this option enabled, a record with the same start and end date will be imported as a daily record for that date.
    <div class="example">

    <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

    If a record starts on 3/1/2016 and ends on 3/1/2016, the data will be imported for 3/1/2016. If this option is not enabled, an error message will display, stating that the end date cannot match the start date.

    </div>

5.  If applicable, select **Meter number field is Import ID**. If you are importing data from a third party, and the meter number in the file is different from the meter number in FLOWCAL, you can set the third-party meter number as the import ID within the Meter Editor.

     If the meter number does not exist in FLOWCAL, the import will fail unless the Auto Create option has been enabled for text file imports. (See: [Service Configuration](../../Settings%20Manager/Services/Service%20Configuration.md))

</div>

Windows has a hard-coded limit of 260 characters for file paths; file paths longer than this will not work. Importing files from a local install allows for using drive letters for network file paths; however, Citrix resolves the actual network location, which can cause the number of characters in a file path to exceed this limit.
